dict.string: TrapVisionPro listens for your "pull" and "bang" voice commands during a round.
TrapVisionPro uses on-device speech recognition to detect the "pull" and "bang" voice commands during a round.
TrapVisionPro tracks your Logitech Muse pointer's position in your surroundings so virtual clays and scoring react correctly to where you're aiming.
TrapVisionPro uses hand tracking as part of tracking your Logitech Muse pointer's position while you aim.
TrapVisionPro tracks your Logitech Muse pointer's position and orientation so it knows where you're aiming.
